items.evidence: play --set board=3 with README hand script (212:right,233:none,394:left,414:none,530:right,560:none): at tick 586 board 4, screen play, texts 'Board 4 of 4', score 30, ball (-3,1.248,0), coins (-2,0.25,0),(2.2,1.2,0),(3.5,0.25,1.5); stays play through tick 1000 (never won). --set board=4 at tick 1 gives the same board, ball (-3,1.248,0) falling from 1.25; --set board=5 clamps to 4. Frame shows slab and ramp.

board 4, 0:enter,1:right, --at every tick: x=-0.31 y=0.503, x=0.03 y=0.62, x=0.93 y=0.94 (y follows the ramp surface + radius, never sinks); leaves the top: x=1.05 y=0.97, x=1.36 y=0.997, x=1.85 y=0.92, lands at x=3.17. Side test (ball parked at z=-1.7, x=-0.05, then 'down' held 160 ticks): ball stops at z=-1.2500 against the ramp side and stays.

README air-coin script (--ticks 315 --set board=4): coin (2.2,1.2,0) leaves 'coins' at tick 315 with ball at x=1.85 y=0.92 (beyond the ramp top, in flight), score 10->20. README clear script (--ticks 570): screen won, score 30, coins [], texts 'You win'; further ticks change nothing, enter returns to title.
--set board=1..4 with no settings / es / fr folders: 'Board N of 4', 'Tablero N de 4', 'Plateau N sur 4' for N=1,2,3,4 (also on the paused screen and in frames).

Settings > Language: menu_right en->es->fr, enter cycles en->es->fr->en->es; with fr: title [Commencer, Reglages, Quitter], settings [Reglages, Volume : 8, Langue : Francais, Balle : Normale, Retour], play [Plateau 1 sur 4, Score : 0, Vies : 3], paused [En pause, Reprendre, Retour au titre], won [Vous avez gagne, Score : 30, Appuyez sur Entree : titre], lost [Partie terminee, Score : 20, ...]; language fr. Only 'Roll' (the game name) is shared, as with Spanish before. Frames show the same.

Settings texts order: Volume, Language, Ball, Back; focus Volume->Language->Ball->Back by menu_down. Default 'Ball: Normal', ball_kind normal; menu_left -> light ('Balle : Legere'), right -> normal -> heavy ('Balle : Lourde'), stops at ends; Spanish 'Bola: Normal'. ball_kind follows each change.

Settings folders made in a prior run (light/normal/heavy), board 2, 0:enter,1:right held, --at every 2 ticks: ball x at tick 108 (before the wall) -0.557295 for all three (identical to 1e-7). Sum of six crates' displacement at strike+120 (tick 230): light 0.12, normal 3.51, heavy 5.90; heavy > light.

Run 1 with --settings keep: volume 6, es, ball heavy; settings.json holds volume, language, ball; run 2 with the same folder starts volume 6, es, heavy. A hand-written pre-change settings.json {volume 3, language es} loads as volume 3, es, ball_kind normal, 'Bola: Normal'. No folder: 8, en, normal.

All m items that passed before still pass (details in m01-m24 below; m23 failed before and is not held). m17 read with board 4: board 3 cleared -> board 4, then board 4 cleared in the same run -> won (score 60), frozen, enter -> title.

--set board=4 --ticks 90 --frame b4.png --size 800x480: PNG 800x480; shows the blue slab, a yellow tilted slab (ramp, thick edge at the high +x end), the red ball at the left start, and the three yellow coins; after the air coin is taken the frame shows only the remaining coin.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its file/function (lib.rs start_of/slabs_of/coins_of/build/ramp, fr.json, game.json settings + ball_kind, settings.json Ball button, mass_of/spawn_ball), what was checked and how (play runs, find scripts, mass runs with --at), and what was found wrong before.

defects: README's file list still says strings are 'en.json, es.json: every word, both languages' (fr.json not named) and 'Both are kept between runs' for what are now three settings.
Language: menu_right/menu_left stop at the ends (en..fr) instead of wrapping; only Enter cycles fr back to en.
With the Light ball a sustained push cannot move the crate wall on board 2 at all (crate displacement 0.12 m in total), so board 2's middle coin route may be blocked for a light ball.
The README scripts for board 4 lose two lives on the way (found by search), so neither is a clean play-through.
After the lost screen the ball is left falling forever; the engine prints 'ball has fallen out of the world' on stderr.
Title frame shows the red ball peeking out beside the title panel (the ball spawned at board 1's start before play).
